verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a server mode exposing an HTTP server and API on localhost:8080, and it is positioned as model, runtime and server in one file. That makes it plausible as a local backend a coding agent could point at. Nothing in the evidence shows the API's compatibility (e.g. OpenAI-style endpoints), tool/function calling, or any coding agent actually connected to it. missing for 10: documented OpenAI-compatible API endpoints, tool/function-calling support, documented setup with a coding agent, hands-on or community corroboration of agent use.
